rows.Synonyms:
• Evita (hybrid tea, Tantau 1982)
• Polarstern ®
• Stella Polare
• TANlarpost
rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: TANlarpost
Exhibition name: Polarstern ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Mathias Tantau, Jr. (1912 - 2006) (Germany, 1982).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Wheatcroft Brothers Ltd. in 1984 as 'Polar Star'.
rows.Bloom: White or white blend. None to mild fragrance. 35 petals. Large, full (26-40 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall, well-branched. Matte, dark green foliage.

Height: 3' to 42" (90 to 105cm). Width: 27" to 42" (70 to 105cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 4b and warmer. Vigorous. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).
rows.Notes:
The first Hybrid Tea to win the Royal National Rose Society's Rose of the Year Award.
Evita Peron was born 7 May 1919 in Colonia Agricola La Union, Argentina. She died 26 July 1952.
